_comment: Gold amendment edges (seeded from the existing Gemini-extracted Feb2026Amendment data). Key = source law number (the act making the change). Drop the matching source-law text/PDF into the --laws-dir as '<source_law>.pdf' or '<source_law>.txt' to score the new extractor against these. Self-loop entries (source==target) are marked suspect:true — a correct extractor should NOT reproduce them as cross-law edges.
